text:
anya: Quick thread (5m). Building the long-term platform pitch for routing/isolation. Need a concise product promise + clear launch gates.

mason: Customers demand predictable latency across regions and an isolation contract for big accounts. We should map to measurable gates.

sarah: Suggest three buyer-facing commitments: latency band per region, isolation tiers (bronze/silver/gold), and a documented failover SLA. Keep the wording simple.

ben: Measurables idea: regional P99 targets; isolation acceptance via smoke harness (no cross-tenant KV hits in X probes); and failover RTO bounds.

luca: Ops: for contractual isolation we need reserved slices, eviction playbook, and automation hooks. Template policies first, DSL later.

evan: Sales needs a single-paragraph blurb + a sample contract clause. Product can draft if eng gives test names.

anya: Draft launch gates to iterate: eligibility (reserved commit or min throughput), isolation_harness v1 pass, latency verification under prod-like load, failover test within tiered RTO, ops runbook + billing delta sheet.

mason: I'll list the acceptance tests and ETA. ben will supply latency-vs-cost knobs.

release-bot: Created ticket PROD-4301: "Routing/isolation product promise & gates" assigned to mason.

anya: Thanks — will review tests in Friday roadmap sync. Keep replies short here. :thumbsup:
